## Problem

What's missing? What can't you currently express in a manifest, schema, or workflow?

## Proposed change

What would you add / change / remove? Sketch the manifest or schema diff if possible.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you think of, and why is the proposed change better?

## Boundaries respected

- [ ] No vendor names introduced as canonical
- [ ] Change fits the modular monolith discipline (one writer per field, declared interfaces, etc.)
- [ ] No new HITL surface bypass

## Linked plan / ADR

If this needs an ADR, link the draft.
